Deq shapes as icon data, SVG strings, raw SVG files and a sprite.

```ts
import { rojHalfSun, toSvg } from "@0xdolan/deq-icons";
const svg = toSvg(rojHalfSun, { size: 32 });
```

Source: [`packages/icons`](../../packages/icons/). Install with `npm install @0xdolan/deq-icons`.

## Per-shape exports

93 generated exports, one per shape, such as `archDot`, `archDotColumn`, `arrowDown`. The [icon list](https://kanilabs.github.io/deq/icons/) shows every shape.

## Functions

### `iconComponentName`

```ts
function iconComponentName(id: string): string
```

The component name of an icon: `roj-half-sun` → `RojHalfSun`.

### `iconExportName`

```ts
function iconExportName(id: string): string
```

The JavaScript export name of an icon: `roj-half-sun` → `rojHalfSun`.

### `nodeMarkup`

```ts
function nodeMarkup(node: IconNode): string
```

The child elements of `node` as SVG markup.

### `rootAttributes`

```ts
function rootAttributes(icon: DeqIcon, options?: IconOptions): Attribute[]
```

The root `<svg>` attributes for `icon` with `options`, unescaped. With default options
the result matches `render(icon.name)` from `@0xdolan/deq-core`. Framework packages
use this so every package writes the same markup.

### `toSvg`

```ts
function toSvg(icon: DeqIcon, options?: IconOptions): string
```

A standalone SVG document for `icon`. With default options it is byte for byte
`render(icon.name)` from `@0xdolan/deq-core`.

```ts
import { rojHalfSun, toSvg } from "@0xdolan/deq-icons";
toSvg(rojHalfSun, { size: 32, color: "#ED2024" });
```

**@throws** {DeqError} `INVALID_OPTIONS` for a bad size, stroke width, colour or title.

## Constants

### `icons`

```ts
const icons: Readonly<Record<string, DeqIcon>>
```

Every icon by catalog id. Importing this keeps all icons in a bundle.

### `packageName`

```ts
const packageName: '@0xdolan/deq-icons'
```

The npm package name.

## Interfaces

### `DeqIcon`

```ts
interface DeqIcon
```

One Deq shape as icon data, rendered with core's default options.

- `name: string`: Catalog id, for example `roj-half-sun`.
- `title: string`: English name, used as the default accessible title.
- `node: IconNode`

### `IconOptions`

```ts
interface IconOptions
```

The options icons support. They only change root attributes, so every icon keeps its
precomputed geometry. For dot scale, rotation, fills or parameters, use
`@0xdolan/deq-core` instead.

- `size?: string | number`: Width and height in px, or any CSS length. Default 24.
- `color?: string`: Stroke and dot colour (CSS colour). Default `currentColor`.
- `strokeWidth?: string | number`: Stroke width in grid units. Default 2.
- `absoluteStrokeWidth?: boolean`: Keep the stroke `strokeWidth` px wide at any numeric `size`. Default false.
- `title?: string`: Accessible title. Default: the English name. `""` marks the icon decorative.

## Types

### `Attribute`

```ts
type Attribute = readonly [name: string, value: string]
```

Root attribute name and value, in the order core writes them.

### `IconElement`

```ts
type IconElement = readonly [ tag: "circle" | "ellipse" | "line" | "path" | "polygon" | "polyline", attrs: Readonly<Record<string, string>>, ]
```

An SVG child element: tag name and attributes, in the order core writes them.

### `IconNode`

```ts
type IconNode = readonly IconElement[]
```

The elements of an icon, drawn in order inside a 24×24 view box.
